name: The Estate — Luxury Real Estate Social Media & Marketing Kit (Canva Template)
description:
Elevate Your Real Estate Brand & Win High-Value Listings

In luxury real estate, visual presentation is everything. The Estate is a high-aesthetic, 10-slide social media and marketing kit engineered for top realtors, brokers, and luxury property marketing teams.

💎 What Is Included:

  • 10 Luxury Property Layouts: 'Just Listed' Feature, 'Open House' VIP Invitation, Neighborhood Guide & Local Amenities, Market Statistics & Monthly Trends, Client Testimonial & Review, Price Improvement Alert, 'Under Contract', and 'Just Sold' victory announcements.
  • Warm Sand & Gold Aesthetic: High-end architectural typography and warm neutral palette.
  • 1-Click Instant Canva Access: Easily swap images with your own listing photos in Canva Free or Pro.
  • Instagram & Facebook Ready: Formatted in optimal 4:5 portrait ratio for maximum screen real estate.
  • High-Resolution PDF & PNG Exports: Print-ready flyers or digital marketing posts.
  • Lifetime Free Updates: Free future template additions.

🛠️ How It Works:

  1. Instant download upon checkout.
  2. Open the Access-Your-Template.html file to copy the kit into Canva.
  3. Drop your property photos into the frames, edit the address and pricing, and post!
